Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Tip Activity Display: Adds a dynamic tip carousel display and rendering countdown timer to the waiting screen. (why: Home has a high median wait time of 201s and previous home wait_info changes won 4 out of 5 tests.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Multi Pet Synchronization Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint reassuring users that signing in will automatically sync and restore existing desktop pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after sign-in, and sign-in hints have a high historical win rate (4 of 8).)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Pet Companion Trait Selection Sub-Flow: Adds an interactive companion personality trait selection sub-flow during the pet picking stage. (why: Adoption is a key bottleneck with only 66.0% conversion and 89s median time.)
3: [home, new_screen] Home Desktop Pet Hatching Minigame Screen: Inserts an interactive egg hatching minigame screen while pet rendering processes in the background. (why: Home median wait time is 201s with long mean delays; interactive engagement during waiting keeps users from abandoning.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Session Recovery Hint: Provides an explicit session recovery safety hint on sign-in to reassure users against app stalls and login failures. (why: Support received 2 emails about sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Companion Preview Hint: Adds an explanatory hint under path choices detailing how each path affects desktop pet interactions. (why: Path selection drops 20.3% of users; clearer expectations help users make faster decisions.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Companion Mascot Display: Adds an animated companion mascot and progress bar during background rendering on the waiting screen. (why: Wait info enhancements have proven highly successful for reducing drop-off during long renders.)

scores.note: Home loses few overall users (94.2% pass), but wait_info changes have strong win rate (4/5 tests).

Adoption is the biggest bottleneck step (66% pass), but a full sub-flow incurs high implementation cost.
New screens in home showed negative results (-2.0%) in previous tests and require high effort.
Low cost hint fix supported by user emails and solid historical hint performance.
Choose_path has moderate dropoff (20.3%); hints show steady positive results (+1.4%).
